facts_from_supervisor19_used_by_design: Exit 0 acknowledged SETTLED, 10 NOT_LAUNCHED, 11 UNSETTLED; 2/12/13/14 refusals. Successful ACK is exactly one compact sorted JSON stdout line; supervisor stderr is written only on refusal/diagnostic paths.

Receipt = bytes_json(s.rec) published by exclusive create, fsync, close, readback, nlink 1. Settlement record is linked_publication (name.staged + hard link) so nlink == 2: the one-link beta reader refuses it BY DESIGN; the bridge does not consume it (redundant receipt-derived content; parent publication binding remains external).

Nested child exit: reap_record stores native_wait_result=[pid,status] and raw_wait_status BEFORE clocks; rc=os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status) (negative=signal); receipt main_wait {pid,native_wait_result,raw_wait_status,leader_reaped,rc,mono_reaped,epoch_reaped}, child_returncode, wait_status_lost.

MAIN captures: sink() creates config stdout/stderr files O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, records original (dev,ino) in s.created; stream record has exactly 22 keys (5 counters, 8 booleans, 6 nullable monos, error, sha256_prefix, sha256_written). final_body reads every evidence/output path: artifacts[path] = {sha256,bytes,inode,nlink,birth_epoch} | None | {error}; ARTIFACT_IDENTITY_CHANGED if nlink!=1 or inode != original created ident; EVIDENCE_MUTATED if digest != sha256_written/launch/samples.

Identities: owned_identities {identity,identity_event_ref,via,root,first_seen_mono,proof}; unproved_history {first_identity,last_identity,...}; helpers report incl identity/settled/signal; census {complete,owned_live,unproved_live,group_live,...}; ACK carries ack_census. Identity dict keys pid,ppid,pgid,status,euid,ruid,traced,comm,uniqueid,idversion.

GO record required by supervisor: decision GO, item==cfg.item, configs {config_sha: BOUND_KEYS values}, not_after_epoch, stability_receipt_sha256; extra keys allowed. receipt.authorization={go_sha256,stability_receipt_sha256,not_after_epoch,stability_epoch,stability_date}.

CONFIG schema: 31 exact keys incl item/argv/env/stdout/stderr/*_cap_bytes/launch_record/receipt/settlement_record/outputs[{path,required}]/output_roots/pins[{path,sha256}]/admission{go_path,...}/fault_injection/creation_channel. All publication/capture/output paths sit directly in output roots; outputs must be distinct; nested roots forbidden.
Dates: start_date/end_date are owned /bin/date text (24-char %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z) or null, never invented.

design.module: RUN/control/beta_supervisor19_adapter_v1.py, stdlib copy/hashlib/json/math only; NO os import, no filesystem/process/clock/date calls, no writes. Nothing at import beyond constants/definitions.
design.request_ref: Caller-authenticated exact {path,sha256} of the parent request record. Its SHA is parent authority supplied by the caller (as adapter3 inputs); the bridge never authenticates its origin.
design.reader: The caller-owned beta_parent_reader_v1 EvidenceReader. Bridge calls only read_bytes(path,cap), last_file(path), report(); never constructs, closes, replaces or caches across calls. Each path acquired at most once per call (coherent private cache); stricter later cap must fit cached bytes else HELD. last_file must be the completed current acquisition (path/completed/bytes_seen/sha256) else HELD. Caller keeps reader on every exception.
design.deadline_check: Original non-renewing callable; called before and after every acquisition and after FULL result assembly; any raise or non-None return => HELD DEADLINE and no further acquisitions. BaseException from any callback propagates unchanged after nothing is fabricated.
